frozen_decisions.decision: Use CompositeNonlinearAssembly and NonlinearAssemblyProtocol as the principal composition seam; do not introduce separate per-physics Newton public APIs.
WP01 defines one canonical residual/tangent and nonlinear-driver contract before any physics migration.
frozen_decisions.reason: Current routes use equivalent but non-uniform residual signs, convergence scales and iteration ownership.

frozen_decisions.decision: WP02 extends accepted-increment transaction semantics to every mutable nonlinear state, including contact and continuation state where applicable.
frozen_decisions.reason: StateTransaction and MaterialStateSession presently cover material/slip use cases but are not a universal atomic transaction.

frozen_decisions.decision: Checkpoint/restart remains a continuation feature only after its payload has declared topology, version and rollback semantics for all participating state families.
frozen_decisions.reason: Current checkpoints persist material states and generic continuation data, but not a declared contact-state payload.

frozen_decisions.decision: The legacy active-set/friction solver remains a bounded compatibility/research route until adapted through the common driver contract; no third Newton framework is introduced.

architecture_debt.finding: No atomic transaction currently spans displacement, material state, contact history and continuation state.
Full Newton, material load-control, arc-length corrector and contact active-set/friction routes retain separately owned iteration loops and convergence semantics.
Penalty contact can compose in common assembly, while active-set/friction state and updated-search loops remain outside the common nonlinear transaction/diagnostics boundary.
Nonlinear checkpoints validate material topology and continuation data but have no explicit contact-state schema, digest or restart compatibility contract.
The bounded mechanics interpretation of total_lagrangian_j2 is unresolved; stress measure, state transport and finite-kinematic claims require Owner approval.
Line-search helpers and compatibility wrappers are duplicated across iteration and load-control modules.
Sparse nonlinear assembly has chunking and counters but no frozen nonlinear assembly scaling/performance contract.
The nonlinear assembly plan keeps immutable element/DOF data separate from trial material history and is a suitable retained foundation.
